Messages.Author: texasjusticar
Messages.Body:
Chanjelin Ward - "Put this card on a vampire you control. Actions
directed at this vampire costs an additional blood. This vampire can
burn this card to cause an action directed at him or her to fail. A
vampire may have only one Chanjelin Ward."

Just wanted to confirm that all you need is a ready controlled Kiasyd
and you can play this on any of your vampires. So for example if you
have a ready Kiasyd you can play a Chanjelin Ward on Henri Lavenant.

That's how we played it due to card text, but somehow it felt wrong and
just wanted verification in case we're overlooking something.
